description: Adds independent coaching workflow status and explicit preparation activity associations. No records are inserted or automatically reassigned.

playbooks.workflowStatus: Draft | In Progress | Ready | Needs Review; applies to installs and practice scripts
playbooks.practiceEventId: Optional scheduleEvents ID for legacy compatibility; required by the UI for new practice scripts

scoutPlays.workflowStatus: Draft | In Progress | Ready | Needs Review

scheduleEvents.gamePlanIds: Array of unique Game Plan IDs in the same workspace; an activity may prepare for multiple games

legacyCompatibility: Missing workflowStatus displays as Draft without inferring readiness. Existing scripts without practiceEventId remain visible as Unassigned in their original Game Plan. Practice-owned scripts use event associations instead of legacy gamePlanId for workspace membership.
lifecycle: Active/Archived remains independent. Practices owning scripts cannot be deleted, changed to a different event type, or unlinked from their last Game Plan until their scripts are reassigned or deleted.
